name: fable gaze
description: Proposal. The quieter Fable, and the eyes are the show: its four sideways eyes close ranks into a line and drift as a group, left, centre, right, one cell a frame at 160 ms; on the third drift the leftmost eye turns amber and the others follow one per drift like a wave, and the antenna pings as the fourth turns; the line opens back into two pairs, each pair meets in the middle as one tall eye, the plain ECHO face in amber, which lies down and splits sideways into four again; then the four spin once as tiny braille pairs, each lit dot stepping up and back down one eye behind the last so the four read as a wave, and each eye lands dark; judge whether amber on the teal visor still reads as eyes at 20 cells.
